description: Matched pair driven differentially: symbols C_{gs1,2}, C_{gd1,2}, C_{db1,2}. ngspice's .pz takes one input port, so the 100-digit roots alone are the reference. From 100 kHz: ngspice opens the port through series inductors, whose 2jωL shunts the gate capacitances' 1e10 Ω by 1e-6 at 1 kHz.
